  • Enum-Konstanten - Details

    • NONE

      public static final LookMode NONE
      The NPC never turns. Its rotation is whatever its position says, and no look packets are sent after the spawn.

      This is the only mode that costs nothing per tick, and it is the right choice for the large majority of decorative NPCs.

    • FIXED

      public static final LookMode FIXED
      The NPC holds a fixed rotation, re-asserting it if something moves it.

      Differs from NONE in that the rotation is actively maintained, which matters for NPCs backed by a real server entity that would otherwise be turned by the vanilla AI.

    • LOOK_AT_VIEWER

      public static final LookMode LOOK_AT_VIEWER
      The NPC turns to face the player looking at it.

      Each viewer is sent a rotation computed for their own position, so every player sees the NPC looking straight at them. This is what players expect from a shopkeeper, and because the rotation is per-viewer it costs one small packet per tracked player per update.

    • LOOK_AT_NEAREST_PLAYER

      public static final LookMode LOOK_AT_NEAREST_PLAYER
      The NPC turns to face whichever player is closest, and every viewer sees the same rotation.

      Cheaper than LOOK_AT_VIEWER for crowded areas — one rotation is computed and broadcast — and correct when the NPC should visibly be attending to one specific person.

    • LOOK_AT_LOCATION

      public static final LookMode LOOK_AT_LOCATION
      The NPC faces a fixed point in the world, computed once and re-sent only when the NPC or the target moves.
